qualification.education_qualification: Master's Degree in Social Work or Ph.D. awarded as per UGC regulations.
qualification.details: Master's Degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever the grading system is followed) in Social Work from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University. A relaxation of 5% shall be allowed at the Master's level for candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC)/Scheduled Tribes (ST)/Backward Classes (BC)/Persons with Disabilities (PwD), as per UGC/Panjab University norms. Cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC/CSIR or a similar test accredited by the UGC, such as SLET/SET, or must have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016, and amendments thereto. Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to 11 July 2009 shall be governed by the then existing UGC Regulations/University Ordinances and shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of the conditions prescribed by the UGC, duly certified by the Registrar/Dean (Academic Affairs). Experience of teaching Postgraduate classes of Master of Social Work.

salary_details.details: ₹1,500/- per lecture, subject to a maximum ceiling of ₹50,000/- per month

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Associate II position at IIT Gandhinagar is 30 August 2026. Ensure all details are submitted accurately before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Associate II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Tech./M.S. or equivalent degree, or a B.Tech./B.E./M.Sc./M.C.A. with at least two years of relevant post-qualification experience to be eligible for the Project Associate II role.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the provided information, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate II position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 90,000, depending on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate II position in the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate II recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to visit the official website or the provided application link to submit their forms.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Project Associate II position at IIT Gandhinagar is a contractual job. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Gandhinagar located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar is located in Gandhinagar, Gujarat. The recruitment is for candidates residing in or willing to relocate to this region.

faq.question: Q9. Does the notification mention any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age relaxation details. Candidates belonging to reserved categories are advised to check the official notification for any applicable age relaxations.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are generally required for online applications?
faq.answer: Typically, for online government job applications, you will need to upload scanned copies of your photograph, signature, educational certificates, and any relevant experience certificates in the prescribed format.
